title: Deep Learning for Protein Secondary-Structure Segmentation in Intermediate-Resolution Cryo-EM Maps: A Resolution-Stratified Benchmark Dataset and Controlled Evaluation.
authors: Pial, Md Ehashan Rabbi; Dehan, Farhan Noor; Sazzed, Salim
one_liner_zh: 该文构建了中间分辨率冷冻电镜图谱中蛋白质二级结构分割的基准数据集并系统评估多种深度学习分割架构，虽聚焦于结构解析中的分割任务而非直接的结构预测或构象采样，但方法可迁移至蛋白质结构计算领域。
abstract: Accurate segmentation of protein secondary structures in cryo-electron microscopy (cryo-EM) maps is crucial for protein tracing and atomic model building, yet remains challenging at intermediate resolutions. Although deep learning architectures have recently been applied to this task, there remains a lack of standardized evaluation protocols and systematic resolution-stratified analyses. Consequently, it remains unclear how segmentation performance varies across finer resolution ranges within the intermediate-resolution regime and how different volumetric segmentation architectures compare under controlled experimental conditions. To address these gaps, we present a nonredundant, resolution-stratified benchmark dataset and a controlled evaluation framework for protein secondary-structure segmentation in intermediate-resolution cryo-EM maps. The dataset comprises 972 nonredundant protein-chain samples from 495 cryo-EM protein structures resolved at 4.5-8.0 A, with voxel-level annotations for helices, sheets, and non-periodic secondary-structure (NPSS) regions. The dataset is stratified into three resolution ranges4.5-5.5, 5.5-6.5, and 6.5-8.0 Ato enable systematic analysis of resolution-dependent segmentation performance. Using this benchmark, we evaluate five representative convolutional and transformer-based volumetric segmentation architecturesU-Net, Residual U-Net, Attention U-Net, UNETR, and Swin-UNETRunder standardized preprocessing, training, and evaluation protocols. Residual U-Net achieves the highest macro-averaged foreground (Macro-FG) F1 score in all three resolution bins, while helices are segmented more accurately than sheets and NPSS regions. All five architectures achieve their highest Macro-FG F1 scores in the highest-resolution bin, whereas performance varies between the two lower-resolution bins across architectures and secondary-structure classes. Overall, this benchmark enables fine-grained analysis of resolution-dependent segmentation performance, supports reproducible method development, and facilitates controlled comparison of future cryo-EM secondary-structure segmentation approaches.
abstract_zh: 在冷冻电子显微镜（cryo-EM）图谱中准确分割蛋白质二级结构对于蛋白质追踪和原子模型构建至关重要，但在中等分辨率下仍具挑战性。尽管深度学习架构近期已被应用于此任务，但仍缺乏标准化评估协议和系统性的分辨率分层分析。因此，尚不清楚在中等分辨率范围内，分割性能如何在更细的分辨率区间内变化，以及不同体积分割架构在受控实验条件下如何比较。为弥补这些空白，我们提出一个非冗余、分辨率分层的基准数据集和一个受控评估框架，用于中等分辨率cryo-EM图谱中的蛋白质二级结构分割。该数据集包含来自495个cryo-EM蛋白质结构的972个非冗余蛋白质链样本，分辨率为4.5-8.0 Å，并带有螺旋、折叠片和非周期性二级结构（NPSS）区域的体素级注释。数据集分为三个分辨率区间——4.5-5.5、5.5-6.5和6.5-8.0 Å——以便系统分析分辨率依赖的分割性能。利用此基准，我们在标准化预处理、训练和评估协议下，评估了五种代表性的卷积和基于Transformer的体积分割架构——U-Net、Residual U-Net、Attention U-Net、UNETR和Swin-UNETR。Residual U-Net在所有三个分辨率区间中均取得最高的宏平均前景（Macro-FG）F1分数，而螺旋的分割准确性高于折叠片和NPSS区域。所有五种架构在最高分辨率区间中均达到其最高的Macro-FG F1分数，而在两个较低分辨率区间中，性能因架构和二级结构类别而异。总体而言，此基准支持对分辨率依赖分割性能的细粒度分析，促进可重复的方法开发，并便于未来cryo-EM二级结构分割方法的受控比较。
